name: claude-code-for-codex
description: Use Claude Code from Codex to review code or delegate tasks.

interface.longDescription: Run Claude Code from inside Codex: hand off a substantial coding task, get a read-only or adversarial review of your changes, transfer the current Codex session across, and manage the background jobs it starts. The inverse of OpenAI's Codex plugin for Claude Code.
defaultPrompt: Have Claude Code review my changes on this branch.
Hand this debugging task to Claude Code.
Show me the Claude Code jobs still running.
